messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — I'm proposing a small Terraform rollup for the Karpenter provisioner + HPA tweaks to reduce churn on low-traffic pods. Posting diff and config snippets below, please review when you get a sec.

maya: Terraform change (plan):
```
resource "karpenter_provisioner" "worker" {
  provider = "aws"
  ttl_seconds_after_empty = 900  # bump from 300 -> 900
  consolidation = true
  labels = { team = "inference", tier = "worker" }
}
```
Reason: nodes were terminating too aggressively during short tails; 15m TTL should reduce spin-up cost for bursty jobs.

aj: thanks — curious how this interacts with our HPA for model-inference svc. Which HPA config are you thinking?

maya: current HPA on inference-api sets minReplicas=2, maxReplicas=30, targetCPUUtilization=70. I'm proposing to add a targetMemoryPercentage and `behavior` to prefer scale-down slower:
```
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: inference-api
spec:
  minReplicas: 2
  maxReplicas: 30
  metrics:
  - type: Resource
    resource:
      name: cpu
      target:
        type: Utilization
        averageUtilization: 65
  - type: Resource
    resource:
      name: memory
      target:
        type: Utilization
        averageUtilization: 75
  behavior:
    scaleDown:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 600
      policies:
      - type: Percent
        value: 20
        periodSeconds: 60
```
This makes scale-down more conservative so nodes don't drop as fast and Karpenter TTL is longer.

ryan: small Q: what about VPA? We currently have a VPA object set to "Off" for inference-api because we manage resource requests via ML infra. If VPA were set to "Auto" it might fight HPA. Keep it Off? :thinking_face:

maya: yes keep VPA Off for this deployment. I've added a note to the change: `vpa.mode = "Off"` and included the annotation `cluster-autoscaler.kubernetes.io/safe-to-evict=false` for pods that cannot be preempted during scaling.

aj: Also check Cluster Autoscaler (we still have CA in some nodegroups for non-karpenter clusters). Will the Terraform change accidentally touch any CA settings? I don't want mixed autoscalers fighting each other.

maya: this TF module only touches the Karpenter provisioner in the karpenter module for the `eks-inference` workspace. Not touching CA ASGs or nodegroup scaling policies. But good call — I'll add explicit module-level comments and a guard: `enable_cluster_autoscaler = false` for the workspace to avoid confusion.

ops-bot: CI pipeline: terraform fmt/validate passed on branch maya/karpenter-ttl

ryan: for secrets wiring: the provisioner needs the IAM role with `sts:AssumeRole` and the provisioner SA annotated with `eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn`. Are you updating the IRSA mapping or re-using existing role?

maya: re-using existing karpenter controller role. No cross-account changes. I'm adding the comment in TF and will include the exact annotation in the helm values: `serviceAccount.annotations: { "eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/karpenter-controller" }`

aj: nit: bumping TTL helps, but could cause node fragmentation if workload has many small long-lived pods. Any plan to compact nodes? consolidation=true should help but maybe we should add a weekly cron job to run `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets` on labelled low-util nodes to force packing?

maya: good point — consolidation=true will evict cheaper nodes, but I'll add a low-risk nightly job that targets nodes with label `karpenter.sh/ttl-extended=true` and utilization < 10% for > 2 hours and just cordons them first. I'll open a separate PR for that job.

ryan: ok from infra/security side — just ensure the cordon/drain job uses a locked-down SA and logs to audit.

maya: yep — will do. Plan to merge this TF change tomorrow morning if no objections. cc @aj @ryan :ear_of_rice:

aj: lgtm, please include a blurb in release notes about HPA behavior change.

ryan: lgtm from me too. ops-bot: approve deploy?

ops-bot: Approval recorded: maya.terraform (policy: infra-review-required). Plan/apply scheduled for 2026-03-20 08:00 UTC.

maya: thanks all, merging after final CI run. :shipit:
